messages:
maria: CI red on flaky test: tests/runtime/scheduler_test.py::test_preempt_race — failing ~1/10 runs on linux-x86_64 and macos-latest. Seen in nightly and PR #3421. Full trace attached: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

lee: ugh. can you paste failing stdout? ci-bot?

ci-bot: [build 12345] test failed: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/12345/logs

maria: gist of log:
```
E AssertionError: expected task to preempt but both ran
... stack ...
socket.timeout: timed out waiting for heartbeat
```

sam: @maria can you rerun with STRESS=1 and -k? I can run a local bisect if needed.

maria: rerunning now on linux: `pytest tests/runtime/scheduler_test.py::test_preempt_race -k preempt -q` -> still fails after 2 runs :(

raj: could be timing nondeterminism in TestScheduler: uses real time.sleep(0.005) in loop. Suggest monkeypatch time.monotonic or use fake clock.

lee: +1 to fake clock. adding that is low risk. but need to confirm flake frequency.

sam: I'll kick off a 200x stress run on aws-spot (c5) and run bisect across last 50 commits. putting logs to /tmp/preempt-bisect

sam: command I'm using:
```
export STRESS=1
for i in {1..200}; do pytest -q tests/runtime/scheduler_test.py::test_preempt_race || break; done
```

maria: thanks. ping me when you have a repro or commit range. marking as flaky in test matrix to skip on macos for now :pensive:

ci-bot: test flaky label applied to PR 3421

sam: first reproduce at commit a1b2c3 -> last passing at a1b2b8. narrowing...

raj: if it's a real timing race, adding `time.sleep(0)` or increasing waits may stabilize. prefer controlled fake clock.

lee: can we add a quick harness that runs the test 50x in CI for PRs touching runtime? maybe opt-in.

maria: let's do: add a flaky-tester job that runs only for runtime changes. @sam can you open a quick PR with bisect findings + proposal for fake clock? I'll review.

sam: will do. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome, thanks team. updating issue #778 with notes.

devops-bot: scheduled spot instance group run 50 jobs, id spot-run-879

sam: update: repro consistent with STRESS=1 and STRESS_SEED=42. bisect points to commit a1b2c3 where scheduler preemption optimization landed.

lee: ok that's actionable. can we revert that small change for now and put back behind feature flag?

maria: agree. open revert PR and include fake clock change in follow-up. closing coordination here.

raj: thanks all. :heart:
